title: What is the difference between a regular function and an arrow function?
expectedConcepts: Lexical this binding vs dynamic this
Constructor usage (arrow functions cannot be used with new)
hints: Think about what happens to "this" inside a callback.
Notice the difference between explicit return { return x; } and implicit return (x => x * 2).

codingExercise.instruction: Convert the regular function function double(n) { return n * 2; } into a concise one-line arrow function named double.
